subject: MAP & evaluation plan — final prep for e-signing and kickoff week
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@orbithealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP & evaluation plan — final prep for e-signing and kickoff week

Alicia — attaching the final mutual action plan (v3) and the SOW for your review. Highlights: 
- MAP is locked on scope and acceptance criteria; we replaced the pilot evaluation metric with the alternate latency cohort you requested.
- Proposed signature window: next Wed–Thu (May 26–27). We can hold the e-sign window open for 72 hours if legal needs extra time.
- Target platform start date (production provisioning + onboarding): Mon June 7. That assumes e-sign by May 27 and a 5-business-day onboarding window.

Open items for your team: procurement PO (if required), SOC2 evidence request (we can give scoped artifacts), and your preferred start-of-week for onboarding calls.

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-v3.pdf, SOW-OrbitHealth-2027.docx, OrderForm-Orbit-3891.pdf

Thanks — I can hop on a 15-minute call tomorrow if you want to run the dates with Procurement.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: MAP & evaluation plan — final prep for e-signing and kickoff week

Irene — thanks for sending. Quick notes:
- The MAP/SOW looks good overall; our security team asked whether we can get SOC2 scoped artifacts (not full report) before e-signing. Ben (copied) will confirm exactly which artifacts are acceptable.
- Can we push the start date one week later to June 14? Our internal PM has a release freeze earlier that week.
- Procurement: we'll likely raise a PO instead of credit card. Procurement, please confirm typical lead time for e-sign + PO.

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP & evaluation plan — OrbitHealth timing question

Looping you both in — Procurement wants a PO and the customer needs SOC2 artifacts before they sign. They also asked to move start date to June 14. Proposed internal plan:

1) Confirm we can provide scoped SOC2 evidence (system description + control references) by EOD Friday, May 21. Karthik — can Security/Compliance produce that scoped pack?
2) Offer DocuSign envelope with a 5-business-day signature window starting Tue May 25 to accommodate PO lead time. If Procurement needs longer, we'll extend to 72 hours + PO intake buffer.
3) If start date shifts to June 14, update provisioning ramp and assign a dedicated onboarding engineer for week of June 14. Lauren — can you reserve an onboarding slot week of June 14?

Quoted for context:
> On Wed, 19 May 2027 at 11:02 AM Alicia Gomez <alicia@orbithealth.com> wrote:
> > Irene — thanks for sending. Quick notes:
> > - The MAP/SOW looks good overall; our security team asked whether we can get SOC2 scoped artifacts (not full report) before e-signing. Ben (copied) will confirm exactly which artifacts are acceptable.

If we can turn the SOC2 pack around quickly, I think we keep momentum and meet their new timeline.

— Irene
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@orbithealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@orbithealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated: e-sign link + SOC2 scoped artifacts + revised start date

Alicia — quick update and next steps after internal check: 

- SOC2: Karthik confirmed we can provide a scoped evidence bundle (system overview, control mappings for Data Encryption, Access Controls, Incident Response) by COB Friday, May 21. This should satisfy security's request for artifacts prior to signature.
- Signature flow: I created a DocuSign envelope to keep things moving. Link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/EnvelopeID-9f2a (expires May 27). If Procurement needs longer for PO intake, we can extend the envelope window — just tell us days needed.
- Start date: we can shift provisioning & onboarding to week of June 14. New target: provisioning begins Mon June 14; onboarding kickoff Tue June 15. This gives your PM the release buffer you mentioned.

Action items for OrbitHealth:
- Procurement: start PO process; let us know expected PO ready date so we can coordinate sign-to-provision timing.
- Ben: confirm SOC2 artifact acceptance (Ben, reply to-all with a single-line OK if the list above is sufficient).
- Alicia: once you confirm, we'll send the DocuSign envelope to the signers and set a 5-business-day signing window.

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-v3.pdf (unchanged), SOW-OrbitHealth-2027.docx, OrderForm-Orbit-3891.pdf

Thanks — we'll keep the envelope live and stand by to extend if Procurement needs it.

— Irene
From: Ben Rodgers <ben.rodgers@orbithealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@orbithealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@orbithealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Updated: e-sign link + SOC2 scoped artifacts + revised start date

Irene — the scoped artifacts list looks fine to us. That will be sufficient for our security review prior to signature. Procurement — we will raise a PO and target having it in the system the week of May 24; expect to route for approvals by May 26.

We are good to proceed with the DocuSign envelope; Alicia will coordinate signers on our side. Start date of June 14 (provisioning) / June 15 (kickoff) works.
